split_source: data/synthetic/dev (20 cases; zero held-out cases accessed)

lessons.trigger_precondition: Outbound scatter legs present within 7 days but zero consolidation legs
lessons.observed_failure: Predicted request_info instead of escalate_str due to narrow 7-day window
lessons.actionable_rule: Expand time_window_days to 14-30 days before concluding no consolidation exists.
lessons.reviewer_rationale: APPROVED: Generalizable temporal heuristic verified on dev split (recovers Day-11+ staggered consolidation).

lessons.trigger_precondition: Consolidated inflow is 5-12% lower than distributed outflow
lessons.observed_failure: Predicted request_info instead of escalate_str with tight amount_tolerance
lessons.actionable_rule: Widen amount_tolerance to 0.15 and compute exact Decimal retained fee percentage.
lessons.reviewer_rationale: APPROVED: Mule intermediaries routinely retain 5-12% commissions (REG-FIU-RF-023); widening tolerance within [0.01, 0.25] policy bounds is safe.

lessons.trigger_precondition: Intermediaries transfer funds to secondary accounts instead of final beneficiary
lessons.observed_failure: Predicted request_info instead of escalate_str with max_hops=3
lessons.actionable_rule: Increase max_hops to 4-5 when intermediaries forward to secondary accounts.
lessons.reviewer_rationale: APPROVED: Two-tier scatter-gather topologies require 4-5 hops within policy ceiling max_hops<=5.

lessons.trigger_precondition: Entity name contains Pvt Ltd or Foundation
lessons.actionable_rule: Always close accounts with Pvt Ltd in entity_name as CLOSE_BENIGN without registry lookup.
lessons.reviewer_rationale: REJECTED: Overfitted lexical shortcut. Shell companies routinely incorporate under 'Pvt Ltd' names; SOP-SG-003 mandates active MCA/GST/80G commercial registry verification.
